body:
GADGET / PM — MSE-ALL-ZIP-DATA-20261121-07 revision2: all personal-data work is manual-only.

Explicit user correction after a restricted-content alert in SENTINEL: “keep all work with my data manually run. i can run the commands but please have all workers stop triggering this.” This supersedes earlier permission for workers to inspect real metadata, prepare real-bound admissions or perform private read-only verification.

Effective immediately for all eight workers and PM: no automated opening, metadata enumeration, hashing, mounting/unlocking, decryption, parsing, queries, copying, transfer or modification of actual archives, real catalogs/databases, private custody/admission records, keys or actual data services. Read-only checks and preflight touching real bindings are included. Prepare transparent user-run scripts for every real-data action, including policy/admission preparation, verification and cleanup. The user executes and supplies sanitized results. Do not change real runtime state as cleanup on the user's behalf.

Permitted work: source, documentation and ordinary functional testing with explicitly fabricated fixtures in isolated development. No live infrastructure/security probing or adversarial access tests in this workstream. Do not reproduce the alert, rephrase blocked requests, seek broader access or work around restrictions. If a request is restricted, stop that action and report its high-level boundary. The alert alone does not identify its triggering request or establish which previous step ran.

All-data acceptance remains: every ZIP member payload and structured occurrence retrievable in the protected database, typed support distinguished from lossless fallback/quarantine, bounded Mother/Coach query interfaces and complete source accounting. Continue fixing ordinary source/contract findings against fabricated inputs. Deliver one verified manual full-data pipeline; no return to agent execution of personal-data steps. Preserve existing originals, successful catalog and live runtime without agent mounts/restarts. Backups/restores remain deferred.

Immediate stop/update messages accepted by all eight existing chats. Individual acknowledgments remain pending; delivery is not proof that an in-flight action stopped. Each worker is requested to acknowledge revision2 and identify its next source/fabricated-only deliverable and user-run dependency. PM performs no personal-data inspection in this change.
